title: Predicator conformance manifest
description: conformance/manifest.json - the index a sibling reads first: the ISA version this corpus was generated against, a content hash, and one entry per tier naming the opcodes it unlocks, its case count, and its file. Generated by mix corpus.generate; never hand-edited.

corpus_hash.description: sha256:<hex> over the canonical corpus content, in tier order. The pin a ratchet registry (px-35i.8) references.

tiers.description: One entry per known tier, in ascending tier order. Running tier N means running every file for tiers 1..N, not tier N alone.

name.description: The tier's name from docs/isa.md's tier table, e.g. "core", "arithmetic".

opcodes.description: Every opcode this tier unlocks (cumulative-safe: a tier-3 runner also needs everything tiers 1-2 unlock) - not the opcodes any particular case in the file happens to use.
